name: WDZD Swap factory unprotected pair-token sweep
summary: The unverified Swap factory exposed 0x4d7a4d9e(pair, token) without access control. It called the pair's factory-only 0x33604058(token), which sent the pair's whole WDZD balance to the factory. With the WDZD reserve emptied, the attacker sold 1 WDZD through the project's router for most of the pair's ETH, and repeated this in nine transactions.
notes: The factory, pair 0xe0c352c56af65772ac7c9ab45b858cb43d22f28f (swap-LP, WDZD-ETH) and router 0x3c4e06d17e243e2cb2e4568249b6f7213c43c743 are unverified. A call to 0x4d7a4d9e from an arbitrary address succeeds at block 28353521, while calling the pair's 0x33604058 directly reverts with 'Swap: FORBIDDEN'. campaign.mjs found no call to 0x4d7a4d9e other than the attacker's nine.

The factory's reset is the owner's 0xb95999cd(router, 8) in 0x84a7da2e. It granted the router the role the pair checks (0x46003a3d) before it pays out a swap, and the exploit's sale went through the router. That grant came 94 blocks after the pair was created. The router's signed-sale function 0x543f56bd is the ordinary user path: other users called it successfully shortly before the attack (0xf519cf52, 0x1a880780).
Loss is the ETH the pair paid out, including the router's 10% fee leg to 0xed9a7384d141799fa283d01647f8d23c56b0e4d9. The swept 13,962,126 WDZD stayed in the project's factory and is not counted.
